narr: Deep monsoon moisture over northern Arizona porduced severe thundertorms with damaging winds and flash flooding.
ev: Yavapai County ALERT stream gage measured a 1.5 ft rise on Big Bug Creek in Mayer.
The gage at Aqua Fria below Ash Creek (YAAA3) showed a quick, 3 foot rise. Flash flooding would have occured upstream prior to the reported rise at YAAA3.
